scope: Remaining full H3/I2 440-job completion, conditional on other jobs finishing inside the measured prefill-FFN tail; excludes downloads, validation, reports, later stages. Detailed live evidence covers 41 Qwen BusyBarn prefill FFN workers.

summary.principal_tail: Gemini seed123 must finish best-state backends and then ten terminal-state backends; primary raw file is absent at this snapshot.

other_jobs_sanity_check.calculation: Schedule all 399 non-Qwen-prefill-FFN jobs from zero on the other 87 slots using original complete-job estimates, without credit for 180 already finished; longest-estimated first. This is a comparison estimate, not a live full queue reconstruction.

assumptions: Current progress JSON and process elapsed were read sequentially; use max of both clocks. Four progress timestamps are a few seconds ahead of process status, so timestamps are not simultaneous.

Search extrapolation uses cumulative seconds per completed step and subtracts age of last checkpoint; remaining search scenario scales that rate by 0.8 and 1.2. A task still reporting search retains at least one mean step rather than being called complete.

A3h backend center uses the previous exact same class full ten-seed cost, scaled by current Gemini/previous-A3h mean interval. This ratio mixes contention and mapping differences, so it is an estimating assumption, not a measured A3h slowdown.

A1 has no complete first-seed interval at this snapshot. Its g0_l6 first seed has already exceeded the old A3h seed average; elapsed first-seed time is treated as a lower observation, not a completed duration.

Gemini primary seed intervals are observed; the extra terminal-state evaluation of seed123 is unmeasured and may differ from its best state. Its extra ten calls are included with explicit 0.8 to 1.25 interval factors.
Ranges are working scenarios, not statistical confidence intervals or completion guarantees. Normal queuing, runtime variation, or a different terminal-state backend cost can shift them.
CPU and memory availability can improve as short jobs finish; no speed-up from that future event is required by the center estimate.
Original 117 to 235 minute starting plan is retained separately. No code, simulation, spec, queue, or active process was changed to make this estimate.
